label: Teacher Clarity
description: How clearly the tutor explains concepts and instructions (Hattie d~0.75)

label: Feedback Quality
description: Specificity and usefulness of feedback (Hattie d~0.70; paper specific-vs-generic contrast)

label: Scaffolding
description: Stepwise support provided to the learner; granularity of hints

label: Prior Achievement
description: Student baseline knowledge before interaction (paper Sec 1.2 context variable)

label: Language Background
description: Student language context affecting interpretation (paper Sec 1.2 context variable)

label: Engagement History
description: Historical participation and persistence (paper Sec 1.2 context variable)

label: Student Confidence
description: In-flow confidence signal during learning; aligns with GLP Y4 Uncertainty Calibration

label: Error Rate
description: Frequency of incorrect attempts; aligns with GLP Y2 Error Trajectory Coherence

label: Hint Dependency
description: How often the student relies on hints; aligns with GLP Y7 Scaffolding Response Curve

label: Learning Outcome
description: Measured learning or transfer outcome; in paper Sec 2.3 this is a diagnostic serving as the inference target
